note: NEW FAMILY (v0.6.0, hand-authored spec fixture — Rust-native, no Flask recording exists; DECISIONS.md 2026-08-24). SEEDING (fresh DB, self-host login, BEFORE the import — one duplicate + one new per category): 1) POST /api/mood {mood: 4, date: "2025-08-01", content: "Great workout day.", selected_options: [1, 5]} — pre-seeds the first entry in the file; 2) POST /api/goals {title: "Meditate", description: "10 minutes", frequency_per_week: 3} — pre-seeds the first goal in the file. Then POST this body. Merge-skip semantics (DECISIONS.md 2026-08-24): entry dup key is (date, content) — "Great workout day." on 2025-08-01 is skipped, "Beach day." is imported; goal dup key is title — "Meditate" is skipped WHOLE (its completions are ignored; existing streak state is never mutated), "Journal" is imported with its completion rows. Selections resolve-or-create by exact name: Emotions/happy resolves to the pre-seeded default option, Custom Tags/beach creates both the group and the option. Imported rows keep the file's created_at/updated_at via COALESCE(?, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP). Rows are processed in file order inside ONE transaction; NO achievement checks and NO activity_log rows are produced. Response is exactly {status: "success", entries: {imported, skipped}, goals: {imported, skipped}} — integer counts, nothing else. Re-POSTing the same body is idempotent: everything skips (both categories then answer {"imported": 0, "skipped": 2} — counts are per file row).
